title: Move the replay audit out of the Amplify deploy
description: Replace AWS Amplify Git-connected builds with GitHub Actions CI/CD and manual artifact deployment. Data replay and report generation happen only in a contributor-local preparation workflow; GitHub validates source and site behavior, builds the static artifact, and deploys that exact artifact only after main CI succeeds. Amplify hosts prebuilt artifacts only, with no repository build spec.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Log 2026-09-23: filed after the author objected to evaluations in Amplify CI. Plan: SITE_SKIP_REPLAY in amplify.yml, replay step kept in scripts/site-build.sh for local make ci, new .github/workflows/replay.yml.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Log 2026-09-28: Implemented the repository-side CI/CD migration. Removed the Amplify build spec and GitHub replay workflow; added a GitHub Actions workflow that tests/builds committed site data, caches package stores, passes only `site/dist` to an OIDC deployment job, and waits for manual Amplify deployment status. Added local-only `make refresh-site-data`, `make verify-record`, and `make verify-publish` targets plus AWS/GitHub cutover instructions. Validation: Python suite passed (196 passed, 15 skipped); local replay reproduced `studies/` byte-for-byte; regenerated leaderboard data was stale and is included. Existing site signed-shift test still fails with 12 rendering assertions, unrelated to this change.
